title: CLOOPD: Closing the Learner Loop in On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.24141v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) pays twice for each fresh batch: the student generates trajectories and a stronger teacher scores them. Existing methods improve which trajectories are scored and how the teacher signal is constructed, but usually consume it with one actor update. We introduce CLOOPD, a closed-loop framework separating teacher-signal acquisition from student-side realization. CLOOPD selects an adaptive $\alpha$ waypoint inside a KL envelope, freezes the scored batch and its advantages, re-forwards the student after each actor pass, measures realization, and allocates actor work under a separate token budget. The framework includes deterministic two- and three-pass policies, token-priced CLOOPD-TPMR, and a budget-matched control. Across six 300-step runs on an 8-H20 node, every CLOOPD policy improves the one-pass TOP-D anchor at comparable teacher-token scale: macro accuracy rises from 15.41 to 17.78 with CLOOPD-Fixed2 and 19.

translated_title: CLOOPD：在策略蒸馏中闭合学习者回路
translated_abstract: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）对每个新批次付出双重代价：学生生成轨迹，而更强的教师对这些轨迹进行评分。现有方法改进了哪些轨迹被评分以及教师信号如何构建，但通常仅通过一次演员更新来消耗该信号。我们提出CLOOPD，一个将教师信号获取与学生端实现相分离的闭环框架。CLOOPD在KL包络内选择自适应的α航点，冻结已评分批次及其优势，在每次演员遍历后重新对学生进行前向传播，测量实现程度，并在单独的token预算下分配演员工作量。该框架包括确定性的两次和三次遍历策略、按token计价的CLOOPD-TPMR，以及预算匹配的对照组。在8-H20节点上的六次300步运行中，在相当的教师token规模下，每个CLOOPD策略都优于一次遍历的TOP-D基准：使用CLOOPD-Fixed2，宏观准确率从15.41提升至17.78，以及19.
tldr: CLOOPD提出一种闭环在策略蒸馏框架，将教师信号获取与学生端实现分离，通过自适应α航点、冻结评分批次、重复前向传播学生模型以及在独立token预算下分配演员工作量，显著提升了宏观准确率。
en_tdlr: CLOOPD is a closed-loop on-policy distillation framework that decouples teacher-signal acquisition from student-side realization, using adaptive α waypoints, frozen scored batches, repeated student re-forwards, and token-budgeted actor allocation to substantially improve macro accuracy.
